column1: # Printed tables that restate another one, and how they must agree (lib/views.cross_checks).
# Checked on the year's assembled database (`ExtractTables.py <year> --merge`): per group, each
# summary column against the detail table's facts. Mismatches are listed, never fitted.
# table: the summary table. of: the table it summarises. group: <summary col>=<detail col>,
#   the company id on both sides (`id_ditta`, lib/companies.py), never the name as printed
#   (2026-10-22): the summary lines of one company are added up (DOG M1 prints `CPM
#   ELETTRONICA SRL` twice), whatever their spelling or a name cut short in print.
# cols: <summary col>=<detail col>, the detail column added up by its `sum_sql` (A1 `euro`:
#   its EUR and customs-value rule); `count(<col>)` counts detail rows with <col> printed;
#   `subtotal(<col>)` is the detail table's printed subtotal of <col> (A2 restates A1's
#   subtotals, rounding and all: CALZONI 32.212.217,15 in both, the rows give ...,17).
